## Speaker notes
Press <kbd>S</kbd> in any deck for the presenter view, <kbd>O</kbd> for the
slide overview, <kbd>E</kbd> for print view (then print to PDF), and
<kbd>F</kbd> for fullscreen.
:::

## After the workshop

- [Further reading](further-reading.qmd)
- The [repository](https://github.com/drarunmitra/MedEd_Conclave_2026): fork it and run this in your own department
- Follow-up session: bring your own data. Details by email.

## Feedback {#feedback}

The feedback form is circulated by the SET Team and stays open for one week.
Please include the parts that did not work. The next cohort inherits your
answers.
